model.pts: how soft that defence is in the zones he shoots from
model.threes: how soft that defence is from three, against his attempts
model.reb: misses the opponent generates, plus the share it fails to take
model.ast: assists that defence allows per 100 possessions

note: No price was consulted. These are matchup rankings -- which spots on tonight's slate the model likes, before the market gets a vote. Whether any of them is worth backing is a separate question that needs a line.
